code: local T=workspace.Terrain local n=0 for _,m in ipairs(workspace.Phase1Map.Enterable:GetChildren()) do local cf,sz=m:GetBoundingBox() local r=math.max(sz.X,sz.Z)/2+6 local mn=Vector3.new(cf.X-r,cf.Y-sz.Y/2-24,cf.Z-r) local mx=Vector3.new(cf.X+r,cf.Y-sz.Y/2+8,cf.Z+r) local reg=Region3.new(mn,mx):ExpandToGrid(4) for _,mt in ipairs({Enum.Material.Grass,Enum.Material.LeafyGrass}) do T:ReplaceMaterial(reg,4,mt,Enum.Material.Ground) end n+=1 end local f=workspace.Phase1Map:FindFirstChild('v3_interiors') if f then for _,d in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('Model') and d.Name=='A23_candle_cluster' then d:ScaleTo(0.45) end end end return 'done '..n
